name: Spotty Insect 89
author: KshitijAdhikaree
description: Gradient pill yellow toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from linear-gradient(to right, #090613ef, #18151f) to #000, transform becomes translateX(100%), box-shadow becomes inset 8px -4px 0px 0px #f8f8f4.
